entities.summary: Damien Williams is an American former professional football player who was a running back in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Oklahoma Sooners and was signed by the Miami Dolphins as an undrafted free agent in 2014. Williams was also a member of the Kansas City Chiefs, Chicago Bears, Atlanta Falcons, Las Vegas Raiders, and Arizona Cardinals. He won Super Bowl LIV with the Chiefs by scoring the game-clinching touchdown on a 38-yard run with less than two minutes left in the game.
